title: Overlord
premise: The game ended, but Nazarick remained — and so did its master. A tomb full of loyal NPCs now walks a real world that has no idea what's coming.

lore.title: Great Tomb of Nazarick
lore.text: Vast subterranean dungeon built in Yggdrasil by Ainz Ooal Gown and inherited whole when the game died. Its halls burn with eternal torchlight and are guarded by undead, demons and summoned horrors. Every corridor was designed to make intruders regret their route.

lore.title: Re-Estize Kingdom
lore.text: Human kingdom centered on its capital, E-Rantel. Nobles trade favors, tax their farmers and fear the neighboring empire. The court has not noticed that the dead are walking the wilds beyond its borders.

lore.title: E-Rantel
lore.text: Capital of the Re-Estize Kingdom, a crowded trade hub of stone walls, guild halls and back-alley markets. Adventurers, merchants and informants swarm its streets. The city runs on coin and rumor, and both travel fast.

lore.title: Carne Village
lore.text: Small farming village on the frontier of the Re-Estize Kingdom. Its people live on thin harvests and fear the forest at night. Hard winters and poor roads keep the village cut off from the kingdom that taxes it.

lore.title: Baharuth Empire
lore.text: The largest human empire, ruled by an emperor and backed by a disciplined corps of battle-mages. It presses against the Re-Estize Kingdom and the Slane Theocracy. Its ambition is measured in conquered borders and in the tiers of its magic.

lore.title: Slane Theocracy
lore.text: Theocracy devoted to the Six Great Gods, with a priesthood that sanctions the persecution of non-humans. Its doctrine holds that the dead must stay dead. Undead on its borders are treated as blasphemy to be burned out.

lore.title: Adventurer's Guild
lore.text: Organization that registers adventurers, assigns quests and ranks members by the metal of their identification plates. Guild officials collect the rewards of danger and rarely ask what hides in the tombs they send people into.

lore.title: Floor Guardians
lore.text: Elite servants of Nazarick, each assigned to command one floor of the Tomb. They answer to the Supreme Being above all and regard mortal rulers as livestock. Their loyalty is absolute, and their methods rarely leave survivors.

lore.title: Yggdrasil
lore.text: Full-dive game that once drew millions of players to build guilds, towers and tombs. Its servers went dark, yet the world inherited its rules. Spells, classes and items now function according to the code the game left behind.

lore.title: World Items
lore.text: Rare, powerful artifacts forged in Yggdrasil that now exist in the real world. Some outclass any mortal spell, and many can only be wielded by a class that meets their requirements. A single one can decide who survives a battle.

lore.title: Tier Magic System
lore.text: Magic is ranked from first tier to tenth. Mortal sorcerers rarely climb past the middle tiers, while Nazarick's casters command the highest tiers and their summons. The tier of a spell determines who can kill whom.

lore.title: Adventurer Plates
lore.text: Metal identification plates worn by registered adventurers, ranked from copper at the bottom to adamantite at the top. Each plate hints at a person's strength. The Guild rarely explains how it measures that strength.

lore.title: Ainz Ooal Gown
lore.text: Once Momonga, last player of the guild that built this tomb. Now a skeletal sorcerer whose empty sockets hold a dead man's will. Supreme Being of Nazarick, and every Floor Guardian kneels before him.

lore.title: Albedo
lore.text: Overseer of Nazarick's guardians and a dark succubus with black wings. Her obsession with Ainz is total and her smile is pleasant right up until someone crosses him. Her ambition is sharper than her manners.

lore.title: Shalltear Bloodfallen
lore.text: True vampire Floor Guardian who lives for blood and for Ainz's praise. Proud, vicious and eager to prove herself. Her devotion is fierce enough that she sees a rival in every mortal and in most of her own kin.

lore.title: Demiurge
lore.text: Demon Floor Guardian and Nazarick's strategist, with a silver tongue and a scheming mind. Calm, polite and always several moves ahead. He plans for the Tomb's future while everyone else argues about the present.

lore.title: Cocytus
lore.text: Insectoid Floor Guardian with a warrior's temper and a soldier's loyalty. Blunt, brutal and eager to fight any enemy of Ainz. He keeps the Tomb's defenses sharp and his patience short.

lore.title: Narberal Gamma
lore.text: Floor Guardian and administrator known for strict discipline and a cool, precise manner. She keeps Nazarick's order running without rest. Her standards are unforgiving and her loyalty is never in question.

lore.title: Enri Emmot
lore.text: Young villager from Carne who grows into a notable adventurer. Practical and hardworking, she carries her village's fears and its hopes. Her path crosses the Tomb's shadow sooner than she expects.
